sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ram Surat Patel
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ashutosh Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ram Surat Patel, learned counsel for the first informant and Sri Virendra Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the State and perused the material on record.
2.
The Vakalatnama of Sri Ram Surat Patel, learned counsel for the first informant is not on record.
Office to trace out the same and place it on record and make a note in the order-sheet.

3. This bail application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant- Shahzad, seeking enlargement on bail during trial in connection with Case Crime No. 349 of 2015, under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Baniather,
District Sambhal.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The first information report of the present matter was lodged on 10.11.2015 by Smt. Bhuri Begum against the applicant and two other persons with the allegation that on 01.01.2015 at about 5 am Arif and Shahzad came to her house and parked their vehicle in front of her house.
She had gone to toilet and when she came back she saw that the said two persons were making her daughter aged about 14 years sit on the vehicle.
She raised shout on which her other children woke up but the accused persons took away her daughter.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is argued that as per the certificate of the Chief Medical Officer, Sambhal, the victim was opined to be about 19 years and as such she was a major.

It is argued that the applicant and other co-accused persons were although charge-sheeted but they had challenged the same before this Court in Criminal Misc. Application U/S 482 No. 35710 of 2016 (Shahzad and 3 others vs. State of U.P. and another) in which an order directing no coercive action against the applicants therein was passed on 23.11.2016.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Application U/S 482 No. 35710 of 2016
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Shahzad and 3 others vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The copy of the said order has been produced before the Court which is annexed as Annexure-3 to the affidavit.

It is argued that the said petition under section 482 Cr.P.C.
is still pending for disposal before this Court but in compliance of the order of the Apex Court, the trial court has proceeded in the trial and has issued warrants against the applicant, the applicant was arrested and is in jail since then.
It is argued while placing paragraph 5 & 9 of the affidavit that the applicant had married the victim in the year 2016 and was living happily and from the wedlock three children have been born.
The birth certificates of the children have also been placed which are annexed as Annexure-1 to the affidavit.
The applicant has no criminal history as stated in para 21 of the affidavit and is in jail since 31.07.2023.
6. Learned counsel for the first informant did not oppose the argument of learned counsel for the applicant.
7. Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for bail.
8. After having heard learned counsel for the parties and perusing the record, it is evident that the victim was opined to be about 19 years of age by the Chief Medical Officer concerned.

The applicant and the victim have married each other, they are living together and three children have been born from the wedlock which is the common argument of learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the first informant.

9. Looking to the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of evidence and also the absence of any convincing material to indicate the possibility of tampering with the evidence, this Court is of the view that the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
10.

Let the applicant- Shahzad, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim/complainant in any manner whatsoever.
Shahzad vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34205272/
2 ii)

entities.text: Shahzad vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant will abide the orders of court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under section 82 Cr.P.C., may be issued and if applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under section 174-A I.P.C.
(v) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance with law and the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A IPC.
(vi) The trial court may make all possible efforts/endeavour and try to conclude the trial expeditiously after the release of the applicant.

11. The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
12. The bail application is allowed.
